To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present a novel framework for video analysis that couples the benefits of generative models (HDP) and discriminant models (GP) to classify video events and detect anomalies.

1) we propose an unsupervised framework to learn atomic activities from surveillance videos, which is based on the Hierarchical Dirichiet Process model; 2) we propose an approach to classify multi-agent interactions in real time by combining Gaussian Process and Hierarchial Dirichiet Process models, and 3) we provide detailed experiments on a large dataset showing that our framework is effective and efficient.
we present a new unsupervised learning algorithm that can learn video events from surveillance video and detect abnormal events from real time video.

the problem of unsupervised learning and real time event detection in surveillance videos.
